# Momentus Elite Insights

This documentation assumes that you are comfortable with SQL and the Insights reporting and dashboard tools within Elite.

- The [Views](https://help-insights.venueops.com/views/vw_account_addresses.html) and [Stored Procedures](https://help-insights.venueops.com/storedprocs/sp_room_utilization_by_square_footage.html) sections have details on the **data dictionary** of the MySQL database.
- The [All Views](https://help-insights.venueops.com/articles/all_views.html) article shows all views in a single page.
- The [Recent Changes](https://help-insights.venueops.com/articles/changes.html) article shows all **changes** to the data dictionary since the last release.

If you have received a ["data dump," please review this article.](https://help-insights.venueops.com/articles/dump.html)
